points.text: Is the Arabic text easy to read at phone size?
Does the layout read right to left, with the start of each row on the right?
Do the arrows and chevrons point the right way for Arabic?
Do the numbers and amounts read correctly, with the currency beside the right figure?
Does the back arrow sit on the right and point right?
Does each cart item show its photo on the right and its price on the left?
Does the quantity stepper have its plus and minus in a sensible order?
Do the subtotal, delivery, VAT and total rows line up, with amounts on the left?
Is the total easy to pick out from the other rows?
Is the Place order button full width and easy to spot?
